text: Hino e naafiqi'en, ngantinorayɗo wi'ugol : "Nulaaɗo, duŋano lam tultugol ka jihaadi, wata a fawan yaltidugol e maaɗa haa mi faggitora junibi sabu fitina rewɓe ayɓe Ruum ɓen si mi hawrii e maɓɓe." Anndee ko e fitina ɓurɗo on mo ɓe aaƴotoo ɗon ɓe yani e mun, on woni fitina naafiqaaku e fitina tultugol ngol. Pellet, Ñalnde Darngal, Jahannama fiiltoto heeferɓe ɓen, gooto e maɓɓe fuutoytaako nge, ɓe heɓoytaa kadi laaworde magge.
